objective: Test two bidirectional completed-candle strategies conditioned on a causal rolling variance-ratio regime: anti-persistent Z-score reversion and persistent Donchian breakout. No symbol-specific or timeframe-specific tuning is allowed.

rules.name: V18-VR120K5<0.85-Z60-2.5-RECLAIM+EMA400-EXIT0-H120M
rules.entry: Rolling 120-bar variance ratio at aggregation 5 is below 0.85 and price Z60 reclaims -2.5 for Long or +2.5 for Short on a completed candle, aligned with EMA400
rules.exit: Price Z60 reaches zero, 1% stop or 120-minute timeout

rules.name: V18-VR120K5>1.15-DONCHIAN20+EMA200-EXIT10-H240M
rules.entry: Rolling 120-bar variance ratio at aggregation 5 is above 1.15 and the completed close breaks the prior 20-bar range in the EMA200 direction
rules.exit: Opposite 10-bar range exit, 1% stop or 240-minute timeout

execution.funding: exact Lighter hourly settlements in (entry, exit]
